$comment: Reviewed semantic declaration, one entry per child directory of fixtures/cross-stack/. A directory's location does not determine its class: this file does, and a person decides what goes in it. tests/cross-stack-registry.test.mjs holds it to the tree. Each entry also declares what CI runs for the family: `verification.verify` and optional `verification.falsify` name npm SCRIPTS, never shell strings, so a registry edit can only select a script package.json already defines. A family with nothing to run declares `verification.executable` as `none` (there is no verifier) or `blocked` (there is one and it does not run here), each with a one-line reason. scripts/check-cross-stack-wiring.mjs holds all of that to package.json and to the CI job.

verification.reason: run.mjs resolves the SDK from a sibling checkout path outside the repository and rewrites the recorded results.json, so it neither runs from a fresh clone nor leaves the tree clean; nobulex-bilateral-v0 took the corresponding fix on 2026-08-30 and this family did not
generated regression material with a published generator and seed; it carries vectors and no verifier, so there is nothing for CI to run
